The eyebrow 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' is moved to after the CTA, and the white SOLSTICE wordmark sits on cream at the far right where it can't be seen; the dark brand band is gone. B: the headline is the clear focal point and is readable, but the CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill jammed in the top-left corner above the logo. The logo's white wordmark disappears on the cream background, the eyebrow ends up below the body copy (reversed reading order), and the legal column is cramped against the right edge.
